{{Top|leg}}
'''Hinwuine''', or "a being of standing,"<ref name="NEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> was a right given to visitors to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]] to refer to themselves in the first person. Typically in [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] society, individuals only used the first person if they were someone of note. The right of hinwuine allowed visitors to speak in the first person without being considered rude or vulgar. The members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] were granted hinwuine status when they attended the [[janwuine-jika]] of [[Ooryl Qrygg]].<ref name="TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
